name: House
plan_axes: x east, y north (front/street = south), z up; world = ORIGIN + (x, z, -y)
decisions: Edward's brief (2026-10-28 work order): two storeys; the staircase near the front door, at its top a railing on the RIGHT and a door on the LEFT into the master bedroom; ground: bathroom, kitchen, living room, dining room; upper: two bedrooms, bathroom, master bedroom with its own bathroom; real hinged doors held AJAR (ensuite CLOSED, front + back CLOSED and locked); windows shatter, frames stay, player barriers; cover = furniture at 3.4 / 7+; fair spawns 1v1-3v3

Builder's call (flag for Edward): a second, enclosed BACK STAIR from the back hall to the landing. With one stair the only way between the floors is a single choke the upstairs team can hold; the back stair makes a loop (foyer - main stair - landing - back stair - back hall - kitchen) so each team has two routes.

Both teams spawn on the ground floor at opposite ends (A: living room, B: kitchen), each behind a tall spawn wall; the plan is near point-symmetric (turned 180 degrees about the centre: living room <-> kitchen, main stair <-> back stair, foyer <-> back hall). The upper floor is the contested high ground each team reaches by its own stair. (Tried first: A downstairs / B upstairs. The ground rooms are open plan and the bedrooms closed boxes, so exposure differed by ~50 % and spawn sight by ~25-50 %; no furniture change closed that.)
